title: Don't Shoot Mural
description: Street mural on brick wall depicts five black-stenciled figures with hands raised, each wearing a Nike 'Don't Do It' logo in multicolored variants. Red repeating text 'DONT SHOOT' runs horizontally across the figures; white Mr. Snowmann tags appear at ground level beneath each figure.
